name: Foreign Exchange Trade
definition: Agreement between two parties in which one party buys a currency and the other party sells a different currency.

BuyAmount.name: Buy Amount
BuyAmount.definition: Currency and amount bought in a foreign exchange trade.

SellAmount.name: Sell Amount
SellAmount.definition: Currency and amount sold in a foreign exchange trade.

ExchangeForwardPoint.name: Exchange Forward Point
ExchangeForwardPoint.definition: Difference between the foreign exchange spot rate and the foreign exchange forward rate expressed in basis points quoted in accordance with the prevailing market conventions for the currency pair.

AgreedRate.name: Agreed Rate
AgreedRate.definition: Exchange rate between two currencies. The rate is agreed by the trading parties during the negotiation process.

ResultingSettlement.name: Resulting Settlement
ResultingSettlement.definition: Payment of the settlement amount to the account(s) of the final beneficiary. A payment may be settled gross, through split amounts at several agents of the buyer, or netted with several other treasury agreements.

CurrencyExchangeForSecuritiesSettlement.name: Currency Exchange For Securities Settlement
CurrencyExchangeForSecuritiesSettlement.definition: Securities settlement process for which a currency exchange is provided.

OpeningLegRelatedNonDeliverableTrade.name: Opening Leg Related Non Deliverable Trade
OpeningLegRelatedNonDeliverableTrade.definition: Non deliverable trade for which an opening closing leg is specified.

ClosingLegRelatedNonDeliverableTrade.name: Closing Leg Related Non Deliverable Trade
ClosingLegRelatedNonDeliverableTrade.definition: Non deliverable trade for which a closing leg is specified.

RelatedSwap.name: Related Swap
RelatedSwap.definition: FX swap for which the FX trade is one leg.

RelatedOption.name: Related Option
RelatedOption.definition: Option which is executed by one (or more) FX trade.

CurrencyExchangeForTaxVoucher.name: Currency Exchange For Tax Voucher
CurrencyExchangeForTaxVoucher.definition: Tax voucher for which currency exchange information is specified.

PostTradeEvent.name: Post Trade Event
PostTradeEvent.definition: Information relating to post-trade lifecycle events.
